description: Send a plain-text email from your agent (agents@mail.killbounce.app), $0.005. A new address first gets a short request to allow your wallet (status permission_requested); your message is not sent or queued, so call again once they accept. Each email names the sending wallet and has stop and report links. Limits: 50 a day per wallet, 10 a day per address, max 3 links (no shorteners or IP links). Refused sends are not charged. GET with query params or POST JSON {to, subject, body}. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

body.description: Plain-text body (max 10,000 characters, at most 3 links)
